extracted.intended_audience: readers and students of satirical Renaissance literature / general readers of classic humor
extracted.subtask_description: An English translation excerpt from François Rabelais' grotesque-satirical narrative (Gargantua and Pantagruel), presenting comic episodes and fantastical descriptions (Semiquaver friars, the land of Satin, monsters). Intended as a literary text rather than a guideline or evaluation rubric.
